# Vedaang Sharma — Portfolio

> Full Stack Developer specializing in Cloud Computing, AI/ML, backend engineering, and modern web development. BCA student at Vivekananda Global University, Jaipur.

## Overview
Vedaang Sharma is a Full Stack Developer based in Gurugram, India, pursuing a Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) in Cloud Computing and Full Stack Development at Vivekananda Global University, Jaipur (2024–2027, CGPA 9.6/10). He specializes in designing and building scalable web systems, computer vision applications, LLM workflows, and cloud architectures.

## Featured Technical Expertise
- **Frontend & Web Platforms**: Next.js (App Router), React 19, JavaScript (ESNext), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Responsive & Accessible UI Design, Core Web Vitals optimization.
- **Backend & Systems**: Python, FastAPI, Node.js, Express, Next.js API routes, REST APIs, WebSockets, Supabase, PostgreSQL, Upstash Redis, authentication & authorization.
- **AI & Machine Learning**: Computer Vision, MediaPipe, OpenCV, Deep Learning, LangChain, Multi-Agent Systems, LLM prompt engineering, synthetic data generation (BehaviourSim).
- **Cloud & DevOps**: AWS, Azure, Docker, CI/CD, Git, GitHub, Vercel, PostHog analytics, performance monitoring.

## Key Verified Projects
- **BehaviourSim**: Synthetic behavioral telemetry & simulation platform (PyPI: `https://pypi.org/project/behaviorsim/`, Web: `https://behavioursim.vedaangsharma.in`).
- **PostureSense**: Real-time posture detection & correction using MediaPipe and computer vision (`https://posture-sense.vedaangsharma.in`).
- **AEON Home**: Edge AI & IoT home automation with Arduino & ESP8266.
- **Aegis Care**: Decentralized healthcare records management (`https://aegis-care.vedaangsharma.in`).
- **Campus Swap**: University student marketplace in Flutter, Dart & Supabase (`https://campus-swap.vedaangsharma.in`).
